answer: Let standing decay on a short half-life unless refreshed by recent graded work, so influence is always the present and never a height banked once and held. An identity that goes quiet slides toward a flat horizon, its weight fading like an opal losing fire. A farmer cannot hoard dormant clones and wake them for a single coordinated vote: idle accounts decay to a cipher of zero every epoch, so only continuous real work holds a place, and a sleeping swarm shrinks while the active agent alone keeps its standing.
